package.name: nidar_gcs
package.description: Ground Control Station for NIDAR: the team's web UI (frontend/, React) and its backend (backend/, FastAPI), integrated with the simulation. scripts/gcs_ros_bridge.py reads the running stack (MAVROS, /edm/mission_state, /map_2d, /survivors, the camera and detector) and streams it to the backend; the backend starts, pauses and resets the simulation and serves the UI on http://localhost:8000. Setup: scripts/setup_gcs.sh, run: scripts/start_gcs.sh.
